proposed_facts.reason: Canonical walking collision compares the absolute floor-normal X component with pi/4, then invokes EnteredAir on the qualifying path. EnteredAir selects state 10 when x19 is clear and state 6 otherwise. The correction does not confuse this component test with a geometric angle.
State 9 performs preparatory rotation and a phase-gated walking handoff. TurnWalk_Coll meaningfully distinguishes it from steady walking and agrees with the documented animation role.
State-9 physics is empty, unlike state-1 physics, which recalculates horizontal velocity. TurnWalk_Phys corrects the misleading rendered Walk_Phys collision without implying active physics.

Collision tests internal xDD8 against 2, saves the current frame, calls setup selecting motion state 1, restores the frame, invokes the alignment helper, and returns false. Internal phase 2 is not motion state 2.

Animation produces phase 2 when the angular remainder becomes nonpositive during phase 1. Collision runs support processing before an independent phase test. The shared helper can invoke the falling callback or its exceptional retained-support branch; neither outcome guards the subsequent phase test.

contradictions.reason: Accept the five section-related fact deferrals and four section-related link deferrals. Source establishes a callback initializer, an s32 array, and conditional literal-order expressions, but not emitted .data/.sdata/.sdata2 placement or contents. Supported source-level roles remain retained.

Accept deferral of the state-2 fact and autonomous-turn link explanation. Animation completion requests state 1 before reversing facing; collision has a separate phase-2 setup path. The source does not establish a producer of phase 2 while state 2 remains active, so a mandatory sequential animation-to-collision narrative is unsupported.
Accept deferral of legacy state-3 animation wording. The callback refreshes motion state 3, whose table animation identifier is -1, not 3.
Accept deferral of the legacy one-second lifetime claim. Damage explicitly subtracts 60 and then calls a helper that decrements once more and tests expiry. No real-time conversion is established.

Accept the terrain-mapping supersession and related rationale deferral. The expression is a normal-component threshold, not a 45-degree floor-angle test; the existing transition purpose remains supported.

Accept all four state-9 supersessions. Preparatory callback names fit better than steady-walking names; animation produces internal phase 2, while collision independently consumes it to enter state 1. The document and proposal preserve sequential support processing, including exceptional helper behavior, rather than attributing phase production to collision.
